briefDescription: Daily Life Lessons is an interactive knowledge-sharing platform designed to help users document, reflect on, and share valuable life lessons, productivity tips, and personal growth insights with a global community.
challenges: Implementing Stripe payment gateway for secure online payments.
Managing complex client-side state during real-time post interactions and bookmarking.
Make authentication secure and implement role based authentication
futureImprovements: Add AI-powered personal lesson recommendation engine.
Integrate audio lesson recording and playback capability.
Implement local payment gateway like bkash, Nagad etc.

briefDescription: Reports Zone is an automated analytical and reporting dashboard that allows businesses to aggregate operational metrics, generate visual charts, and export PDF/Excel summary reports seamlessly.
challenges: Processing large datasets efficiently on the backend without causing UI freeze during chart rendering.
Ensuring precise layout fidelity when exporting dynamic charts and tables to downloadable PDF files.
Configuring strict role-based access control (RBAC) for Admin and User permissions.
futureImprovements: Implement scheduled automated email delivery for weekly/monthly PDF reports.
Integrate WebSocket support for live data streaming and real-time updates.
Add custom drag-and-drop dashboard widget customization.

briefDescription: Doc Appoint is a modern healthcare portal connecting patients with specialized doctors. Users can search specialists, book real-time appointment slots, and process secure consultation payments online.
challenges: Preventing double-booking of doctor time slots using MongoDB atomic operations and transactions.
Handling Stripe payment webhook notifications reliably to update appointment statuses instantly.
Designing an intuitive timezone-aware date/time picker for flexible scheduling.
futureImprovements: Integrate WebRTC for in-app direct video consultation between doctor and patient.
Add automated SMS and WhatsApp appointment reminders via Twilio.
Implement digital prescription generation and medical history storage system.
